# Introduction

Have you ever looked at the night sky and noticed that some stars are a different color and wondered, "Why is that?" 

The goal our project is to inform you of how a star is affected by its attributes.


# Data

This presentation uses data from a Kaggle CSV that contains various data about stars for the purpose of classification.

- Link to Data: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/deepu1109/star-dataset
